name: why
summary: Explain a problem: ara why name:Crate not visible, ara why ARA1302, ara why "is the frame slow". Ranked causes with evidence and runnable fixes
usage: ara why [OPTIONS] [QUESTION]...

args.name: [QUESTION]...
args.doc: What to explain: name:Crate not visible, ARA1302, @meshes/crate.glb, did reload fall back to L3, is the frame slow. Quotes are optional

options.name: --doc <DOC>
options.doc: Document for entity names (default: the one holding the entity, else the main scene)

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)

options.name: --full
options.doc: With --json: the whole report (causes with evidence, checks, related), not just the text and the runnable fixes
